title: Natural photo faces and historical likenesses
items: Known portraits now appear on the matching 1904 residents. Dorothy and Alice May Stirling have separate owner-chosen likenesses and period reference portraits; stand-ins are labelled. Generic adults and children retain their photographic faces.

64 new adult and 48 child period references join the existing face library. Historical NPCs follow their existing community and year context; Settings offers the full diverse adult face library independently.
Photographic skin blends across foreheads, cheeks, necks and exposed bodies, with softer child skin detail and more natural eyes and expressions. Known portraits retain their individual identities.
